name: s81ctrl_rg2
hold_budget_reason: CDC leaf: two asynchronous roots (clk stream / ckh HBM) through ot_s81ph_afifo_g; every PHY-face pin is a flop at the face (k_rdy registered since S81-SAFE-FIX 10-19)

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin at its face in its own clock domain (S81-SAFE-FIX 10-19: rq pin register, rd/rk/wd/status output flops on clk; PHY k_rdy/kr_*/k_wr_done pin flops and k_* output flops on ckh -- k_rdy was the last exception and is now a face flop with kept per-group copies). The flow pin-register hook clocks one domain only; on the ckh PHY face it would put clk flops on hclk pins and add a cycle inside the PHY valid/ready loop.

structural_change: S81-SAFE-FIX/CTRL 10-19 SAFE REDESIGN after c1/c2 route miss (TT -6.38 in->reg: PHY k_rdy -> hold-register load enable fanout, 6 levels after the pin; FF -6.55): per-PC channel ot_s81ph_ctrl_pcr replaces ot_s81ph_ctrl_pc (unchanged for closed S81-PH views). (1) k_rdy captured in a face flop; present-then-decide issue (k_v one cycle, decide on the registered k_rdy, re-present a refused word; same PHY valid/ready transfer rule, <= 1 request / 2 ckh per PC); kr_* land in plain pin flops (no kr_v-gated enable). (3) hold-register load enable per 32-bit group from KEPT copies (kv_c/pv_c/krq_c, <= 32 data loads each); FIFOs ot_s81ph_afifo_g read each 32-bit group through its own kept one-hot select + empty copy (no 3-bit pointer driving 340 x 7 mux selects); response output register loads every cycle (no 277-load enable on empty). Reset lands in 2 stages at the face (reset_landing, clk); io_hold_margin 0.03. Outline kept = die PHY-face slot 531.25 x 250 (width = 2 PHY PC pitches, abutted DFI).

job.purpose: dsfd_ctrl_rg2 SAFE redesign (S81-SAFE-FIX/CTRL 10-19): k_rdy face flop + present-then-decide issue, kept per-group enable / FIFO read-select copies, reset landing 2, io_hold 0.03 (c1/c2 route TT -6.38 / FF -6.55)
